versions.description: Steam Profile Guard: checks a player's Steam profile when they join and warns admins about likely alt or throwaway accounts. Rules: account younger than X days, private profile, Steam level below X, fewer than X hours in this game, VAC or game bans newer than X days, and family-shared copies (best effort). By default it only alerts admins (in-game PM to players with the alerts permission, plus an optional Discord channel); per rule you can kick or ban instead. Uses your own Steam Web API key (free). The Takaro instance must allow modules to reach api.steampowered.com (run sgtest; Takaro Cloud blocked it at release). Without a key, or when Steam is blocked, it falls back to the Steam data Takaro stores (age, level, VAC bans). Answers are cached in variables. Exempt players by permission, by the Steam ID whitelist or with sgallow <player>. sgcheck <player> shows a profile now, sgtest checks the API key. Players without a Steam ID are skipped.

commands.name: sgcheck
commands.description: Check a player's Steam profile now
commands.helpText: Usage: sgcheck <player>. Shows the profile and which rules it breaks. It does not kick, ban or alert others.

commands.name: sgallow
commands.description: Stop checking a player's Steam profile
commands.helpText: Usage: sgallow <player>. The player is no longer checked on join on this server.

commands.name: sgunallow
commands.description: Check a player's Steam profile again

commands.name: sgtest
commands.description: Test the Steam Web API connection and key
commands.helpText: Usage: sgtest. Tells you whether Takaro can reach the Steam API and whether the API key works.

hooks.name: check-on-join
hooks.description: Checks the joining player's Steam profile against the configured rules.

functions.name: spg-core

permissions.description: Online players with this permission get a PM when a joining player fails a Steam profile rule.
Allows sgcheck, sgallow, sgunallow and sgtest.
Players with this permission are never checked on join. Roles with ROOT (full access) count as exempt too.
